    VC_ID: VC_SYRS.0270_C.SEN.1
    Title: Verify ECU sends NRC 0x13 for UDS service $22 request with invalid DID field encoding (e.g., truncated 2-byte DID to 1 byte) — violating ISO 14229-1 §8.2.2.2 length semantics
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Fault Injection
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Configure test environment to send a UDS ReadDataByIdentifier ($22) request where the DID field is syntactically malformed: e.g., SID = 0x22, followed by only one byte of DID (e.g., 0xF1) instead of the required two bytes for any standard DID (per ISO 14229-1 Table 156, DID is always 2 octets in $22 requests).
        2. Ensure the total message length is 3 bytes (0x22 0xF1), which violates the minimum defined request length for $22 (4 bytes: SID + 2-byte DID).
        3. Capture ECU <SIG> within 50 ms.
        4. Verify the ECU responds with a negative <SIG> (0x7F 0x22 0x13) — i.e., NRC 0x13 — and *no positive <SIG> or silent drop*.
      Fail: |
        - ECU sends no <SIG> (timeout), a positive <SIG>, an incorrect NRC (e.g., 0x12, 0x31), or a malformed/invalid UDS <SIG> (e.g., missing 0x7F prefix, wrong SID echo).
    Issue_Source: pylessard/python-udsoncan#37

- VC_Item:
    VC_ID: VC_SYRS.0270_C.SEN.2
    Title: Verify ECU sends NRC 0x13 *only* for actual message length violations — not for correct-length requests with valid DID but unsupported/undefined DID value
    Method:
      Type: Dynamic
      Technique: Equivalence Partitioning + Negative Testing
    Pass_Fail_Criteria:
      Pass: |
        1. Send a UDS ReadDataByIdentifier ($22) request with *correct total length*: 4 bytes (0x22 + 2-byte DID), using a well-formed but *undefined/unsupported* DID (e.g., 0xF000).
        2. Confirm the request length matches the DID specification (i.e., 4 bytes is the defined length for all $22 requests per ISO 14229-1, regardless of DID value).
        3. Capture ECU <SIG> within 50 ms.
        4. Verify the ECU responds with NRC 0x12 (sub-function not supported) or NRC 0x31 (requestOutOfRange), *not* NRC 0x13 — because message length is correct.
      Fail: |
        - ECU returns NRC 0x13 despite correct 4-byte request length; or fails to respond; or returns ambiguous/malformed <SIG>.
    Issue_Source: pylessard/python-udsoncan#215
